Connectome Worm: replay

A simulated worm whose brain is the real wiring diagram of C. elegans (282 neurons), trained to crawl towards food by sensing salt. Green shading is the salt concentration; the food is at its peak.

Replay of Python simulations from the wormbrain project (milestone 6 runs; held-out start). Real worms crawl at about 0.2 mm/s, so 1× is real time. Brain: graded neurons on the Cook et al. 2019 connectome; only per-class neuron parameters were trained.
